Identity.History: The Gupta Empire arose in northern India in the early 4th century AD and reached its height under rulers such as Samudragupta and Chandragupta II. Through conquest, diplomacy, and prosperous trade, the Guptas united much of northern India. Their era saw major achievements in mathematics, astronomy, literature, art, and religion before the empire weakened under internal pressures and invasions by the Huns.
